Commit: e4f81afc8c8357034a196841485c7d7055705e07 Channel: beta
fix(app): apply the confirmed wallpaper to the display that asked
Assigning a web wallpaper to a secondary display raised the trust sheet, whose confirm button applied nextCurrentWallpaper to the main display. This path never set that property, so confirming put an unrelated wallpaper on the wrong screen. The pending request now carries the target screen through the sheet.

Commit: 8cfc493fd0226d57dd4c7ab9da54ad9044d45d09 Channel: beta
fix(i18n): translate the screen saver strings
Every entry in the saver's en and zh-Hant tables was still the Simplified Chinese key verbatim. Because the keys are themselves Chinese, the missing translations fell back to the key and read as Simplified in both locales instead of failing visibly.
zh-Hant follows Taiwan usage rather than a glyph-level conversion: 螢幕保護程式, 元件, 載入, 設定, 影片, 壁紙.

Commit: 0377b0c706a01e75bc1ef69013da31a9740fe605 Channel: beta
perf(ui): render rich labels natively, debounce search, cap GIF decode
Every rich Wallpaper Engine property label instantiated a WKWebView, and therefore a WebKit content process. A property panel with fifteen such labels spawned fifteen processes.
Render them with NSAttributedString instead - but not unconditionally. That importer resolves referenced resources synchronously on the calling thread, so swapping it in wholesale would trade process overhead for a main-thread network stall. Only labels referencing a remote image, frame or video still use a web view; everything else is native, which in practice means none. Imported fonts and colours are stripped so the SwiftUI environment styles the text and it stays legible in dark mode, and parsed results are memoised since SwiftUI re-evaluates bodies freely.
Debounce the library search by 250 ms. The pipeline already runs off the main thread, but typing "landscape" still queued nine complete search/filter/sort passes over the whole library of which only the last mattered. The Workshop search already debounced.
Animated hover previews decoded at full resolution: a 1920x1080 GIF with 80 frames decodes to roughly 660 MB, once per cell swept. Play the animation only when its decoded footprint is sane, otherwise fall back to the downsampled still the cell already shows unhovered.
The frame-rate slider now routes through the playback policy rather than pushing the raw value, which would bypass a thermal or low-power cap.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Commit: 761a9103099994d95598b3d753b1232c035b385b Channel: beta
fix(scene): apply container visibility gates to the render graph
Container layers hid themselves through SceneNode::SetVisible alone, but graph build only reads the elision set, so a user property gating a whole group (weekday component, language variant) never reached the renderer. The load-time binding pass then re-lit each child on its own font-variant binding, leaving both language groups drawn until the user toggled the property once. Mark user-gated containers elidable, and let SetNodeVisible queue same-value calls whenever the elision set disagrees with the node flag so a parse-time hide can still be picked up.
Also route text layers through EnsureScriptScene so engine.userProperties and the bone resolvers are seeded when a text layer is the first object to need a JS runtime, resolve effect visibility bindings for text objects, and write a visible-bound script's return value back to layer visibility.
